🚨 NSE clamps down on Static IP misuse in retail algo trading (Circular 58/2026)

✅ Static IP only for tech-savvy retail clients who code their own algos. 

❌ Algo providers can\'t hand it to other retail clients

Brokers must now collect an undertaking. Effective immediately.

2/ Brokers must get an undertaking from each tech-savvy client. It confirms they build their own algos using programming knowledge. 

It also says they have no recourse to the Exchange\'s investor grievance mechanism for losses caused by the algo\'s logic.

3/ Algo providers who break the rules can have their empanelment reviewed, suspended or revoked.
